shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if test -f round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,240p' round-brief.md; else echo NO_BRIEF; fi
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' package.json
printf '\\n--- tests/spec files ---\\n'
rg --files src/orchestration/tools specs adrs | sort | head -80
printf '\\n--- registry references ---\\n'
rg -n \"ToolRegistry|inputSchema|validated by|specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation\" src specs adrs | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
printf '\\n--- validation spec ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
printf '\\n--- git log ---\\n'
git log --oneline -8"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n \"tool_result|execute\\(|maxToolRounds|ToolRegistry\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -120
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; elif test -f scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs; then node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs; else echo NO_REANCHOR_SCRIPT; fi'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '50,115p'
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m "fix tools nested validation paths"
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
